title.narrative: Developing a comprehensive Science, Technology and Innovation Strategy in Lao PDR (2026-2040) through public private consultation and partnerships

description.narrative: As Lao PDR aims to graduate from the LDC status by 2026, there is a pressing need for an official national science, technology and innovation (STI) strategy and action plan that is aligned to the national development priorities. The government needs to work on the current challenge of technological and globalization changes, as well as social transformation through a comprehensive STI strategy, according to the standards of UNESCO Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers (2017). The Strategy will integrate and articulate the national and social and human sciences in a unified way, in support of the implementation of the 10th National Socioeconomic Development Plan 2026-2023. This project will build on the ongoing collaboration (since 2023) between the Ministry and the UNESCO Regional Office (based in Bangkok) by assisting the government in broadening the national consultations with the private sector (including SME) in order to enact an comprehensive and participatory approach while drafting the STI policy.
